title: Unlikely intersections in families of polynomial skew products
summary: Motivated by the study of unlikely intersection in the moduli space of rational maps, we initiate our investigation on algebraic dynamics for families of regular polynomial skew products in this article. Our goals are threefold. (1) We classify special loci -- which contain a Zariski dense set of postcritically finite points -- in the moduli space of quadratic regular polynomial skew products.
